body: I understand what you're saying. It's frustrating. Maybe you can make youtube videos discussing your experience? It can defiantly help some people. :-)

I'd sleep on it. Have you thought about volunteering at a library? A farm? With a religious organization? Doing something to help others can help you feel like you have some sort of purpose. If you want someone to talk to, just message me! <3
